notes:
What's new in 0.1.97:
- Kitchen announcements (In development, off by default): send a short message to household devices open at home. Turn it on in Settings.
- Media requests have a status, an owner note and a Requests page in the browser. Guest requests stay off unless you allow them.
- Get Started shows a background connection test and what to try next. It never changes your router or turns Relay on.
- More podcast websites are recognised, large feeds in one format work again, and a feed lookup hang is fixed.
- Safety fixes: Movie Night and Live TV re-check parental limits straight away, and media requests re-check permissions at every step.
- Remote Desktop (In development, off by default): the keyboard helper starts on PCs that block script files.
- Walkie-talkie from anywhere (In development): every guest must be approved.
- Not yet checked: none of this has been tried on a real PC, phone or TV. Automated tests and reviews only.
- Release source commit 8386dcbcc.
- Published: Oct 21, 2026, 3:43 AM Eastern.
